hook.name: RealmHook
hook.description: Singleton Uniswap v4 hook for the Realm protocol that collects LP fees and time-limited buy/sell taxes on swaps of graduated tokens, forwarding LP fees to a configurable router and taxes to each token's master fee handler. Also emits post-swap pool state events (sqrtPriceX96, liquidity) per swap for efficient off-chain indexing.
